question: Which of the following is the famous festival of Telangana
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bonalu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bonalu** is a famous festival celebrated in **Telangana.**
 
• It is celebrated in the month of **Ashada, **which falls in **July/August.**
 
• The festival is dedicated to the** goddess Mahakali** and is celebrated with great fervor in **Telangana.**
 
• During the festival, **women **dress up in traditional attire and carry decorated pots on their heads filled with offerings to the goddess.
 
• The offerings include **cooked rice, jaggery, curd, and water.**
 
• The women visit temples and offer these pots to the goddess while** dancing** to the beat of drums and music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kanuma **is a festival celebrated in** Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.**

 
 
• It is celebrated as a part of the** three-day Sankranti festival.**
 
 
 
• **Elephanta** is a **UNESCO **World Heritage Site.
 
 
• It is located in **Maharashtra. **
 
 
 
• **Konark** is a famous temple in **Odisha.**
 
 
• It is dedicated to the **sun god Surya.**
